Do not expose private or unnecessary personal information in public-facing SBT records, RAG chunks, or generated summaries.

answering_rules: Use the most specific evidence-backed chunk available.

Do not exaggerate a claim beyond the preferred claim text or evidence summary.
Preserve the distinction between resume-attested claims and publicly verified claims.
For broad biography questions, use identity, SBT overview, and evidence-backed chunks together.
For credential or honor questions, prioritize chunks with claim_id, evidence_id, verification_level, and source_url.
Follow the attribution policy when reusing or summarizing repository information.
Follow the access policy when embedding, retrieving, or redistributing repository information.

governance.official_credential_status: This SBT is not itself an official institutional credential unless a claim is explicitly verified by the issuing organization or supported by an official public source.
maintenance_guidance: Add new evidence items when stronger public sources are found.
Update chunks when claim text or verification levels change.
Avoid including private contact information in public files.
Use stable evidence_id and claim_id values so files can reference each other consistently.
